data.description: 1909 home on 0.27 acres near Hobble Creek. Loft, big front and back yards, patio. Recent upgrades: insulation, new breaker panel, partial sewer work, new fence, carport roof, fresh paint.
Single-family home with two bedrooms and a flex third room with its own outside entrance (massage studio). Private yard, close to I-15.

As-is 1961 brick home needing a full renovation. $150K is a starting price; offers due November 18 at 5 PM, multiple offers expected. Finished basement with separate entrance, corner lot, mountain views.
Recent upgrades: A/C and furnace replaced about a year ago, water softener. Covered patio, near Rees Elementary. Move-in ready.
Price reduced. Near freeway, schools, shopping and parks. Four roomy bedrooms and one full bath, with room to add a second bath in the basement. A/C replaced 2021; roof and siding updated 2017.
Central Springville near downtown. 3-bed, 1-bath with attached garage and carport; room for the buyer's own updates.
Under Contract.

Historic Lehi brick bungalow. Nearly everything new: heating and AC, fixtures, stainless appliances, cabinets, quartz counters, bathrooms, LVP flooring; newer roof, electrical, sprinklers and sod. No HOA rules. Seller financing with $100K down.
Accepting backup offers. Seller offers up to $11,500 toward closing costs or rate buydown. Modern 3 bed with quartz counters, mountain views.
Well-kept 3-bed, 2-bath rambler, fenced yard, mature shade tree, rear lounge area. Kitchen updated with new countertops.
Updated single-level bungalow in Payson with private backyard and plenty of parking.
Price recently reduced significantly. Fenced 0.43-acre lot, RV parking. Updated kitchen with gas range, remodeled bathroom. Needs some repairs and updating.
Refreshed Eagle Mountain home with new main-level carpet and paint, unfinished basement, 2-car garage, HOA amenities.
Vacant 1934 bungalow on a 0.16-acre corner lot. Original-cabinet kitchen, basement with laundry and storage. Sold as-is, suited to renovation or investment.

Back on market after buyer fell through. Updated: new plumbing, electrical, furnace, A/C, water heater, softener and roof, 2023 flooring and remodeled bath. Appliances included. Walkable to library, sports park and shopping. Terms: cash, conventional, FHA.

Recently remodeled rambler with three bedrooms, two bathrooms, two-car garage, private backyard. New kitchen, flooring, HVAC, paint and countertops; xeriscaped front yard. No HOA. Lender credits and transferable home warranty mentioned.
Fix-and-flip / handyman property. Cash offers only, sold as-is, new roof 2024. Occupied, showings by appointment.
Brick home in the center of town, two bedrooms and one bath, mature yard, covered patio.
Sold as-is, suited to investor or renovator. Fenced yard, covered deck, detached 1-car garage.
Back on market. 1909 home needs updates, sold as-is, may not qualify for FHA. 0.38-acre lot with room to expand, shed, RV parking.
Walkable to BYU, UVU, hospital, downtown. Provo owner-occupancy deed restriction: no leasing for first 12 months, no short-term rentals.
1906 home on a 0.34-acre corner lot. Sold as-is, ready for a full renovation. Room for gardening or possible future development.
Remodeled in 2023: new flooring, paint, cabinets, furnace and central air, stainless appliances, granite. Walk-in closet, shed, large mature yard.
Short sale that requires third-party approval. 4-bedroom Springville home, open floor plan, covered patio. Needs updating and TLC; newer roof within last three years.
Santaquin bungalow with good bones for starter, investment or renovation. Sold as-is, no seller disclosures. Under contract.
Open-concept 3 bed on a quiet cul-de-sac near freeways, shopping, parks and schools.
Remodeled 1913 home on a corner lot in central Payson. Updated kitchen, carport, storage sheds, full landscaping, near schools and shopping.
Central Spanish Fork near downtown. Basement entrance could work as a mother-in-law apartment. Oversized 2-car garage with workshop, sprinklers. Possible seller financing.

Single-family home in central Payson near shops and restaurants. New furnace, roof redone about five years ago, upgraded meter and breaker box with solar, sprinkler system mostly finished. Some repairs still underway before closing.
Tri-level Payson home that needs updates and renovation; suits buyers building equity or investors. Square footage estimated from county records.
Under Contract.

Charming 1896 Rambler/Ranch on a 0.27-acre corner lot. Over $30,000 in upgrades: fresh paint, new LVP flooring, updated kitchen, newer roof. Four bedrooms, mudroom/laundry, fenced yard, shed. Unfinished basement.
Lehi bungalow, 2 bed 1 bath, main-level living. HUD home; bidding rules apply. Under Contract.
1916 bungalow on a half-acre lot. No description provided.
Large fully fenced backyard. Fridge, washer and dryer included. Make the home your own.
Under Contract.

Spacious kitchen, family room with fireplace, finished basement with second family room and den. Roof replaced ~2020, solar paid off at closing, large powered shed. Seller offers up to $9,000 rate buydown.

Two-story new-construction home in the Wander community, about 1,033 sq ft, two bedrooms, up to 2.5 baths, island kitchen, two-car garage. Seller offers up to $20,000 toward closing costs with preferred lender. Photos show a different home.

Investor fixer-upper needing sweat equity. Main-level floors and a new electrical panel done. Wood-burning stove, large backyard, covered deck, carport. Upstairs flooring, kitchen cabinets, countertops, paint and curb appeal still need work. Terms: cash, conventional.
Historic 1882 two-story across from Park Elementary, corner lot. Restore and personalize. Under contract.
Under contract. Two-story Moreno home, about 1,033 sq ft, 2 bedrooms, up to 2.5 baths, 2-car garage, in the Wander community.
Rambler/Ranch. LVP flooring, refinished original hardwood in primary bedroom, updated kitchen with stainless appliances, new roof 2024, private backyard, 2 covered carport spaces (no garage).
Brick home in central Spanish Fork, large yard, 2-car garage and RV parking. Affordable with strong potential.
The Moreno: two-story new-build, 2 bed, up to 2.5 baths, 2-car garage in the Wander community. Up to $20k closing costs. Photos show another home.
Single-level ranch, 4 bed 2 bath on main plus finished basement. Evaporative cooling, fenced yard, patio, shed. Short sale requiring third-party approval, sold as is.
Two-story new-build, 2 bed, up to 2.5 baths, 2-car garage in the Wander community. Up to $20,000 toward closing costs with preferred lender.
1940s bungalow with an attached 1 bed/1 bath accessory unit rented at $800/month. Main home has 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, about 967 sq ft. Freshly painted; accessory unit has its own kitchen and laundry.
Back on the market after a buyer withdrew over financing. Small 1908 bungalow, large backyard, no HOA, updated windows, appliances, carpet, water softener, insulation, lighting.
Price-improved 1918 bungalow, 2 bed 1 bath, 753 sq ft on 0.15 acre, landscaped, storage shed, carport. Square footage is a county-records estimate.
Relisted. New carpet, bonus loft (office or extra bedroom), large fenced yard, home warranty included. Seller-reported updates to water heater, furnace, A/C and roof. Near I-15, schools and shopping.

Single-level Provo rental with tenants in place through March 2027. 3-bed, 1-bath rambler with attached garage, covered patio, workshop area, landscaped yard. Near BYU and UVU; suits investors or owner-occupants.

Recently price-improved ranch home kept up by its original owner. Roof about four years old, fenced backyard, partly finished basement with plumbing stubbed for an extra bathroom. Square footage is a county-records estimate.
